lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters of varying diameters, arranged in a structured geometric grid posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a mesh-like anchor node system across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges running longitudinally across the upper and middle sections of the visible flank, defined by a high-contrast transition from light (top) to shadow (bottom).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of two ectoparasitic remoras attached to the lower flank; one large, high-luminance white specimen and one smaller, slender specimen located further posterior.
